cards.front: What should you know about all living organisms are made of cells.?
cards.back: Cells are the basic building blocks of life. Some organisms are unicellular (made of one cell, like bacteria) and some are multicellular (made of many cells, like humans).

cards.front: What should you know about eukaryotic cells?
cards.back: have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles. Animals, plants, fungi and protists are eukaryotic. Prokaryotic cells do not have a nucleus. Bacteria are prokaryotic.

cards.front: What should you know about animal cells?
cards.back: are eukaryotic cells that contain: a nucleus, cell membrane, cytoplasm, mitochondria, and ribosomes. They do NOT have a cell wall, chloroplasts, or a permanent vacuole.

cards.front: What should you know about plant cells?
cards.back: have everything an animal cell has, PLUS three extra structures: a cell wall, chloroplasts, and a permanent vacuole.

cards.front: What should you know about bacterial cells?
cards.back: are prokaryotic. They are much smaller than eukaryotic cells and have a different structure. They have no nucleus - their DNA is a single circular chromosome found free in the cytoplasm.

cards.front: What should you know about microscopes?
cards.back: let us see cells and their structures. Light microscopes use visible light and glass lenses. Electron microscopes use electrons and can magnify much more.

cards.front: What should you know about tip?
cards.back: Always check the units in the question and answer. Convert everything to the same unit before calculating. Exam questions often mix mm and μm.

cards.front: What should you know about common errors?
cards.back: Coverslip not lowered at an angle (traps air bubbles); using too much sample; not starting on lowest magnification.

cards.front: What should you know about answers?
cards.back: (a) Actual = 6 ÷ 3000 = 0.002 mm = 2 μm. (b) The white blood cell image is 50% larger in the image (9 mm vs 6 mm), so its actual size is also 50% larger (3 μm vs 2 μm) since both are at the same magnification. The conclusion is correct.
